column2: [intro]
In my life, I do as I please,
No need for serious big ideas, just ease.
I prefer the nights and the fireside glow,
Let others handle politics, let them go!
I want to have fun, unplug and play,
Live the party life without delay!
Dance all night, with no regrets in sight,
Let me laugh and enjoy, it's my right!
No need to stress or get too profound,
Lightness is my go-to, the joy I’ve found.
I don’t dive into grand causes or fights,
I prefer to joke around and keep my nights.
Forget the debates, the revolutions too,
Live the party life, that's my view!
No worries, just illusions and cheer,
Freedom to think without any fear!
[ solo ]
I want to have fun, unplug and play,
Live the party life, come what may!
Dance all night, with no regrets in sight,
Let me laugh and enjoy, it feels right!
[outro]
